name: Commercial Trade Settlement
definition: Settlement of a commercial trade, that is, the instruction to deliver goods or services against the payment of an amount of money.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Settlement of the payment side of a commercial trade.

Invoice.name: Invoice
Invoice.definition: Specifies for which invoice the settlement takes place.

LetterOfCredit.name: Letter Of Credit
LetterOfCredit.definition: Written undertaking by a bank to honour a demand for payment.

ProductDelivery.name: Product Delivery
ProductDelivery.definition: Delivery of the goods or services to the buyer.

CommercialTrade.name: Commercial Trade
CommercialTrade.definition: Specifies the commercial trade which is settled.
